caption: The drawing depicts an ornate and luxurious interior featuring several distinct objects and furnishings. At the foreground, there are four large, black, leather armchairs arranged in a semi-circle on a patterned reddish-brown rug. Two of the chairs have newspapers placed on them: one with the headline "WAR IN SPAIN" and another draped over the armrest. To the right, on another chair, there is a brown hat and two small flags (one being the American flag). A round silver ashtray with a cigar and a cup sit on the rug in front of the chairs. There is a green bottle marked "PLONK DE LUXE" on the floor to the left. The background displays tall, fluted columns with light blue and white coloring, supporting a series of arches. A large statue of a woman draped in flowing garments stands on a pedestal near the center. Various chandeliers with multiple light bulbs and crystal accents hang from the ceiling. At the left, a green upholstered chaise lounge or settee with a high tufted back is placed against a blue wall, accompanied by a lamp and a small side table. Above the settee, there is a decorative wall clock and a mural of two pink-robed figures among clouds. Numerous green plants, some large and leafy, are scattered throughout the space. The floor is covered with a black and white checkered tile pattern. In the right midground is a tall vase adorned with colorful flowers sitting on a pedestal, and a table with various objects behind it. In the background, there are more seating areas, elaborate railings, intricate wall and glass patterns, and additional architectural details contributing to the ornate composition of the room.
title: Foyer Men's Club, 1880-1910
